recaps.title: Politics & Washington
recaps.intro: House Democrats made Hakeem Jeffries their speaker pick while Congress grilled security officials over the nationwide tech outages and Iran threats. The Senate Democratic leader race kept splitting the caucus.
recaps.label: From posts on X

bullets.text: House Democrats nominate Hakeem Jeffries for speaker in a 251-11 vote
bullets.note: He is on track to be the first Black speaker; the full House votes Jan. 3 with Democrats holding a commanding majority.

bullets.text: House Democrats pick Rep. Ted Lieu as caucus chairman
bullets.note: Another leadership post filled as Democrats prepare to take the House majority in January.

bullets.text: Security officials tell Congress they found no evidence the recent tech outages were linked or caused by cyberattacks
bullets.note: The outages hit airlines, banks, Microsoft services and national security communications systems.

bullets.text: Sen. Josh Hawley demands answers on the string of outages, questioning whether they could all be coincidental
bullets.note: NBC reports the administration is under growing pressure from the right over its response to the outages.

bullets.text: DHS Secretary Markwayne Mullin says Iran and Tehran-backed actors have targeted US critical infrastructure
bullets.note: His written testimony came ahead of Congress's annual worldwide threats hearing.

bullets.text: Mullin defends using a government plane to attend the LSU-Texas game during a nationwide ground stop
bullets.note: Rep. Bennie Thompson criticized the trip as irresponsible.

bullets.text: GOP committee chair criticizes FBI Director Kash Patel for skipping the worldwide threats hearing
bullets.note: The FBI deputy chief testified alongside Mullin at the House hearing.

bullets.text: Senate Democrats boycott a hearing over frustration with Trump nominations
bullets.note: The Hill says the walkout stemmed from frustration with the president's nominees.

bullets.text: Pakistani man Asif Merchant sentenced to more than 27 years for a foiled plot to kill Trump
bullets.note: He told the court he had been recruited by Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps, the DOJ said.

bullets.text: Sen. Angela Alsobrooks will back Schumer over Van Hollen for Democratic leader
bullets.note: Bernie Sanders says he is doing his best to whip votes for Van Hollen.

recaps.title: World
recaps.intro: Trump, Xi and Putin gathered in Shenzhen ahead of their first three-way summit as the Iran war kept the Gulf tense. Israel, Gaza, Ukraine and the Netherlands also made news.
recaps.label: From posts on X

bullets.text: Trump to meet Putin in China amid a renewed push to end the Ukraine war
bullets.note: Axios reports the meeting comes amid a renewed push to end the war in Ukraine.

bullets.text: Putin appears in an APEC leaders' family photo for the first time in nine years, beside Xi and Trump
bullets.note: Bloomberg calls it a powerful rebuff of Western efforts to isolate him; the first formal three-way summit is Thursday.

bullets.text: Xi and Putin condemn sanctions as Trump arrives in China
bullets.note: Their remarks came as Trump landed in Shenzhen for the APEC summit.

bullets.text: Xi shakes hands with Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi in their first official interaction since ties soured
bullets.note: Relations deteriorated late last year after Takaichi's comments about Taiwan.

bullets.text: Insurance for a single Strait of Hormuz transit has soared to 64 million dollars, a senior US Navy official says
bullets.note: Raises questions about claims that the waterway is open for business as Iran-US strikes continue.

bullets.text: Israel's spy chief lobbied for joint strikes on Iran during a US visit, sources tell Reuters
bullets.note: The report comes as US and Iranian forces keep trading strikes in the Gulf.

bullets.text: Israel's attorney general delays a controversial West Bank settlement project
bullets.note: A person familiar says it will be halted at least until a new government forms.

bullets.text: Palestinian families flee homes and tents in central Gaza as Israeli forces launch a new operation
bullets.note: The army says it aims to eliminate a threat to its forces near the Yellow Line.

bullets.text: Russian air attacks across Ukraine kill at least five, a day after a Ukrainian strike partly collapsed the Kerch Bridge
bullets.note: The Kerch Bridge strike killed two, authorities said.

bullets.text: Dutch Prime Minister Rob Jetten salvages his minority government after four days of talks
bullets.note: Avoids a third national election in the Netherlands in less than four years.

bullets.text: The UN atomic watchdog will name a Russian official under Ukrainian sanctions as its nuclear energy chief
bullets.note: The pick drew criticism from observers and Kyiv's government.

bullets.text: The ICJ will rule Thursday in The Gambia's genocide case against Myanmar over the Rohingya
bullets.note: Al Jazeera calls it a landmark case accusing Myanmar of genocide against the Rohingya minority.

recaps.title: Market open
recaps.intro: Stock futures rose before the bell as Nvidia's results eased AI worries, though its shares later slipped. Fed Governor Waller called for a half-point December hike, retailers Target, Lowe's and TJX beat forecasts, and Anthropic was said to guide its IPO above range.
recaps.label: From posts on X

bullets.text: S&P 500 futures rose 0.4% and Nasdaq 100 futures 0.9% before the open, with Dow futures nearly flat
bullets.note: WSJ and FT said stock futures rallied as Nvidia's results eased fears about the AI trade.

bullets.text: Nvidia shares turned negative after rising 5% following its earnings
bullets.note: Reuters says Nvidia's forecast soothed AI demand worries, but the question of who succeeds Jensen Huang has become central for its shares.

bullets.text: Fed Governor Waller called for a half-point rate hike in December
bullets.note: He argued for 50 basis points in December rather than splitting it into quarter-point hikes in December and January.

bullets.text: The 10-year Treasury yield rose 2 basis points to 5.12%
bullets.note: The move came minutes after Waller's comments backing a bigger December hike.

bullets.text: October housing starts jumped 9.9% to a 1.309 million annual pace, while building permits fell 7.4%
bullets.note: Starts beat the 1.25 million estimate; permits came in at 1.295 million versus 1.375 million expected.

bullets.text: The average 30-year mortgage rate rose 14 basis points to 7.35%, and mortgage applications fell 2.3%
bullets.note: Mortgage Bankers Association figures for the week ended Nov. 13.

bullets.text: Target beat third-quarter forecasts and raised its full-year profit outlook
bullets.note: Adjusted EPS was $2.65 versus $2.08 expected on $27.07 billion in sales; it now sees full-year adjusted EPS of $10.65 to $11.40.

bullets.text: Lowe's third-quarter comparable sales rose 1.8% and adjusted EPS was $3.10, both above estimates
bullets.note: It now sees full-year sales of $92.5 billion and adjusted EPS of about $12.25.

bullets.text: TJX third-quarter comparable sales rose 4% on $16 billion in sales, above estimates
bullets.note: It sees fourth-quarter comparable sales up 2% to 3% and plans $3 billion in buybacks during fiscal 2027.

bullets.text: Anthropic is said to be guiding its IPO pricing above the marketed range
bullets.note: Reuters says it could be one of the biggest IPOs in history, priced into one of the most nervous tech markets in years.

bullets.text: SpaceX plans a $40 billion AI chip financing arranged by Apollo that stays off its balance sheet
bullets.note: The deal would fund AI chips without adding the debt directly to SpaceX's balance sheet.

bullets.text: The Commerce Department is setting new rules to stop some foreign actors from using US-based advanced computing power
bullets.note: A Federal Register notice says the aim is to protect US national security and foreign policy interests.

recaps.title: Morning briefing
recaps.intro: Trump landed in Shenzhen for APEC as Xi broke protocol to greet him, while Iran widened attacks on Gulf states. At home, Democrats flipped Alaska's Senate seat and House Democrats move to pick Jeffries for speaker.
recaps.label: From posts on X

bullets.text: Xi Jinping breaks precedent to greet Trump on arrival in Shenzhen for the APEC summit
bullets.note: Trump is set to meet Xi and Putin in Shenzhen, China's tech hub.

bullets.text: Democrat Mary Peltola defeats Sen. Dan Sullivan, flipping Alaska's Senate seat
bullets.note: It is the ninth Republican-held Senate seat Democrats flipped, their biggest midterm gain in nearly 70 years.

bullets.text: Bahrain and Kuwait say they intercepted weapons launched by Iran after US strikes on Qeshm Island
bullets.note: Iran appears to be stepping up attacks on US allies in the Persian Gulf.

bullets.text: Crew abandons a gas tanker hit by a projectile in the Strait of Hormuz, sources say
bullets.note: Shipping through the strait remains under attack.

bullets.text: Rubio says he sees no imminent threat to Washington after reports of an Iran dirty bomb plan
bullets.note: He spoke Wednesday after reports Iran may be planning an attack in the capital.

bullets.text: House Democrats are expected to nominate Hakeem Jeffries as their next speaker on Wednesday
bullets.note: Some incoming progressive members have declined to back him.

bullets.text: Chris Van Hollen's challenge to Chuck Schumer for Senate majority leader intensifies
bullets.note: Both are lobbying colleagues ahead of a Dec. 1 secret-ballot vote.

bullets.text: House Democrats prepare a broad probe of the Trump family
bullets.note: Democrats take the House majority in January.

bullets.text: Supreme Court declines Trump administration push to cut DEI-related research grants
bullets.note: A setback for the administration's effort to cut the grants.

bullets.text: White House pulls FDA nominee Heidi Overton after support from Senate Republicans wavered
bullets.note: The nomination was withdrawn.

bullets.text: FBI says the US has seized more than 1.2 billion dollars in crypto stolen from Binance
bullets.note: The FBI also blamed North Korea for a separate 400 million dollar scheme.

bullets.text: Congo's Ebola outbreak is spreading and killing at a record pace
bullets.note: The outbreak remains out of control six months after it was declared.

bullets.text: UK hands a US Army officer arrested on suspected national security offenses to US military custody
bullets.note: He was arrested in Britain last week in an espionage probe.

bullets.text: Grand Theft Auto VI begins its global rollout
bullets.note: It is the first game in the franchise in more than a decade.

recaps.title: AI & tech
recaps.intro: Nvidia's post-Huang era dominates, with China chip shipments halted and Huang keeping board nomination rights. Anthropic nears pricing a record IPO as lawmakers push for more disclosure.
recaps.label: From posts on X

bullets.text: Nvidia stops shipping US-approved AI chips to China
bullets.note: A new limit on Nvidia's China business.

bullets.text: Interim CEO Colette Kress reassures investors on Nvidia's first earnings call since Huang's exit
bullets.note: She pledged to be disciplined in how Nvidia commits capital.

bullets.text: Jensen Huang can nominate two directors to Nvidia's board, filings show
bullets.note: It gives the co-founder a route to future influence at the company.

bullets.text: Democrats probe whether Howard Lutnick helped Cantor avoid Nvidia losses, the FT reports
bullets.note: The Nvidia fallout is reaching the Commerce secretary.

bullets.text: Trump administration weighs forcing US firms to disclose their use of Chinese AI, Reuters reports
bullets.note: An exclusive report on a possible new disclosure rule.

bullets.text: US limits on advanced AI chips for Chinese firms set the stage for Trump-Xi talks at APEC
bullets.note: Beijing warns of retaliation, and expectations for a breakthrough are limited.

bullets.text: Anthropic is on the cusp of pricing potentially the biggest IPO of all time
bullets.note: Pricing comes after a churn in tech stocks.

bullets.text: Crypto futures tied to Anthropic's debut imply a value of about 1.7 trillion dollars
bullets.note: That is well above the 1.4 trillion dollar top of its proposed IPO range.

bullets.text: Democrats demand more transparency ahead of Anthropic's 1 trillion dollar market debut
bullets.note: Lawmakers call current disclosures the bare minimum.

bullets.text: US senators warn the White House that AI-enabled cyber threats are outpacing defenses
bullets.note: Senators say defenses are falling behind AI-enabled threats.

bullets.text: Waymo temporarily pulls its robotaxis off US freeways after California's ban
bullets.note: The latest in a series of setbacks for the robotaxi industry.

bullets.text: Tencent's revenue misses estimates as it reorganizes around a bold AI bet
bullets.note: A setback for the founder's AI push at China's most valuable company.

bullets.text: Samsung downplays concerns that neocloud firms could fuel an AI bubble
bullets.note: The memory chip leader says they are only a small share of the market.

bullets.text: South Korea offers 75,000 dollar bounties to catch students using AI gadgets to cheat on its college entrance exam
bullets.note: The exam is this week.

recaps.title: Sports
recaps.intro: Quentin Grimes' 47 pushed the Lakers to nine straight, and Zverev became the first ATP Finals semifinalist. Bedard faces more tests and only two players took MLB qualifying offers.
recaps.label: From posts on X

bullets.text: Quentin Grimes scores a career-high 47 with 10 threes as the Lakers rally from 18 down to win their ninth straight in OT
bullets.note: He joins Kobe Bryant as the only Lakers with 10 or more threes in a game.

bullets.text: Brice Sensabaugh scores 40 with 11 rebounds and 8 threes as the Jazz win on the road
bullets.note: He is the youngest player in NBA history with 40-10-8 threes in a game; 25 came in the fourth.

bullets.text: Texans place leading tackler LB Azeez Al-Shaair on injured reserve
bullets.note: He will miss at least the next four games.

bullets.text: Steelers G Mason McCormick suffered a dislocated ankle but no fracture and needs no surgery
bullets.note: He was carted off in an air cast on Sunday.

bullets.text: Titans place WR Wan'Dale Robinson on injured reserve
bullets.note: Tennessee loses the receiver to injured reserve.

bullets.text: Week 12 flex: Raiders at Browns moves to Sunday Night Football; Patriots at Chargers moves to 4:05 p.m. ET
bullets.note: Titans at Jaguars moves to 1 p.m. ET.

bullets.text: Blackhawks say Connor Bedard is headed for further testing after leaving with an injury
bullets.note: Coach Jeff Blashill said the team is concerned.

bullets.text: Stars complete a late comeback as Miro Heiskanen scores the OT winner in his return
bullets.note: Dallas tied the game in the final seconds of regulation.

bullets.text: Cutter Gauthier scores another hat trick for the Ducks
bullets.note: The Ducks forward had another three-goal game.

bullets.text: World No. 1 Alexander Zverev beats Ben Shelton 6-2, 7-6 to reach the ATP Finals semifinals
bullets.note: He is Turin's first semifinalist and is 2-0 in the John McEnroe Group.

bullets.text: Yankees closer David Bednar accepts the qualifying offer, a one-year 23.15 million dollar deal
bullets.note: Twins C Ryan Jeffers also accepted.

bullets.text: Randy Arozarena, Brandon Lowe, Seiya Suzuki, Adrian Morejon and Trevor Rogers decline qualifying offers
bullets.note: They remain free agents.

bullets.text: Red Sox add no prospects to their 40-man roster before the Rule 5 protection deadline
bullets.note: Boston cited lockout uncertainty and a crowded roster.

bullets.text: Michigan hires Texas A&M's Trev Alberts as its athletic director
bullets.note: Michigan is expected to cover his 4 million dollar buyout.

bullets.text: Tennessee beats No. 2 Michigan State by 15 in men's college basketball
bullets.note: It is the Vols' seventh straight home win over AP top-5 teams.

recaps.title: Vermont on X
recaps.intro: A quiet, mild stretch of weather, an attack outside the Chittenden County Courthouse, and new numbers on school health costs, Canadian visitors and home buying.
recaps.label: From posts on X

bullets.text: Dry, warm weather continues today with gusty summit winds around 35 mph
bullets.note: Overnight lows ran about 5 degrees warmer than average.

bullets.text: VT-100 in Stowe at Farr Hill Road reopened after a crash closed it Tuesday
bullets.note: The road was back open at 2:26 p.m. Tuesday.

bullets.text: A mental health caseworker was attacked outside the Chittenden County Courthouse; her client faces an attempted murder charge
bullets.note: Police say the attack happened Monday.

bullets.text: Vermont schools expect their lowest staff health insurance increase in years
bullets.note: Districts still face tough choices as they build budgets.

bullets.text: Canadian visits to Vermont fell about 28 percent in 2025, a state report says
bullets.note: Canadian spending in Vermont has plummeted with cross-border tourism.

bullets.text: Study finds big investors rarely swoop in to buy Vermont homes
bullets.note: The finding speaks to a heated housing debate in Vermont.

bullets.text: Vermont's Truth and Reconciliation Commission releases a draft report on state-sanctioned harm
bullets.note: It includes the state's role in the eugenics survey.

bullets.text: South Burlington's City Center fills up with more development ahead
bullets.note: Restaurants and residents are starting to fill the area.

bullets.text: Vermont deer hunters adapt to big changes in rifle season rules
bullets.note: Rifle season started this past weekend.

bullets.text: Pride Center of Vermont's board shares a new vision after its closure
bullets.note: The board laid out its plans Tuesday.
